verdict.rationale: Zapier's Platform CLI explicitly supports building webhook triggers (subscribe/unsubscribe patterns) alongside polling triggers, and this is a core, well-documented capability for integration builders including AI-native/agent use cases via CLI, MCP, and Workflow API. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of webhook subscription specifically (vs. polling) and no explicit example of an AI agent subscribing to a webhook end-to-end.
